breakpoints.note: After the newline path has NUL-terminated the buffered 25-byte command, `ProcessCommand` forwards that completed CLI line to the interpreter.

This is the first staged project statement on the crashing path that consumes attacker-controlled input: each non-newline UART byte is appended into `mRxBuffer`, building the CLI command string later terminated and parsed.

When the final `.` selects embedded-IPv4 mode after 14 IPv6 bytes have already been written, this subtracts four bytes from `endp`, moving it to `mFields.m8 + 11` while `dst` is already `mFields.m8 + 13`. The fixing patch inserts `VerifyOrExit(dst <= endp, error = OT_ERROR_PARSE)` here; in the staged vulnerable source execution falls straight to the compaction loop with `dst > endp`.
